description:
Validate a deployment description and return the whole kit as text.
        Schema 2: deployment.json, launch.sh, launch.ps1, install-service.sh,
        remove-service.sh, install-service.ps1, remove-service.ps1, broker
        reference config and README, with the start order and the applications
        whose automatic equipment writes need local consent. Schema 1: the
        original read-only instance manifest and wrappers. Does not read local
        paths, run scripts, install services or provision identities. Supply
        only relative graph paths; never credentials. equipment_writes is a
        request the local operator confirms, not an authorization.
        Example: prepare_deployment_bundle(document={"schema_version": 2, "name": "Cell", "services": [{"name": "broker", "kind": "mqtt-broker", "port": 1883}], "applications": [{"alias": "hmi", "graph": "hmi.lazy", "mode": "desktop", "equipment_writes": "operator", "depends_on": ["broker"]}]}).

document.description: The deployment description as a JSON object (schema 2: name, services, applications, optional machines and addresses). See describe_deployment_bundle.
document.title: Document

name: prepare_deployment_bundle
title: Prepare a deployment kit
